title: Reactor Reboot
description: Toggle 3D cuboid regions on/off and count total active cubes.
writeup:
## Approach

Each instruction turns a cuboid region on or off. Brute-force voxel counting is infeasible for part 2's enormous coordinates. Instead, maintain a list of disjoint "on" cuboids.

For each new instruction, subtract its cuboid from every existing on-cuboid using geometric splitting — slicing off up to 6 non-overlapping pieces around the intersection. If the instruction is "on", add the full new cuboid to the list. This ensures no double-counting.

## Part 1

Process only instructions whose ranges fall within `[-50, 50]`. Sum the volumes of all resulting on-cuboids.

## Part 2

Process all instructions without restriction. The same algorithm handles arbitrarily large coordinates since it works with cuboid geometry, not individual voxels. The cuboid list grows linearly with each instruction but remains manageable (~10K cuboids for typical inputs).
